visibleevidence.target: Second complete line; four-letter Name immediately after מצות, on right
marks: Two vertically separated dots below yod: sheva.
Detached upper dot directly above the vav head, slightly to its right in the raster; clear holam-like dot, distinct from letter strokes.
Qamatz below vav: horizontal bar with central downward stem/dot.
No additional visible marks on the two he letters.
visibleevidence.encoding_note: Literal spatial association gives yod+sheva, he, vav+holam+qamatz, he. Holam may conventionally be encoded on preceding he; this report preserves visible placement rather than imposing familiar pointing.
